If the GitHub CLI returns a message containing the PR number or branch name derived from attacker-controlled input (e.g. a crafted branch name or title), that text reaches the RuntimeError and propagates to callers — potentially logs or API responses. The `--draft` flag is appended as a flag with no argument, so there is no injection vector there. However, `base` (line 84) is appended as a positional value to `args` without any constraint visible in this diff. A `base` value containing shell metacharacters or a leading `--` could influence `gh` argument parsing.
